messages:
jen: Heads-up — planning to flip /api default -> v2 on Wed 03:00 UTC. Need pinlist + clear rollback criteria before window. @deploybot schedule t=2026-03-24T03:00:00Z, run id please. cc @matt @chris

deploybot: Scheduled rollout: v2 default route for /api at 2026-03-24T03:00:00Z. run_id=20260324-03-00-7955550000. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Auto-rollback thresholds configurable.

matt: Noted. Mobile squad: can we request a 24h tenant hold for older SDKs? mobile SDK < 1.4.2 still using legacy header behavior. Recommend pinlist: mobile_sdk<1.4.2

lucy: Confirmed. QA hit a streaming edge case on v2 with older clients (streaming chunk boundaries). Request 24h hold for tenants with streaming=true. I'll add to pinlist.

chris: Canary telemetry so far looks fine in staging (p50 +5ms, errors ~0.02%). One tenant showed streaming 422s — low volume. Suggest canary->50% then pause if streaming-422 > 0.5% sustained over 5m.

ops-runner: Rollback/runbook notes: to rollback run:
```
deploybot rollback --run 20260324-03-00-7955550000 --target v1
# or: curl -XPOST https://deploy-api.internal/rollback -d '{"run":"7955550000","target":"v1"}'
```
Fallback route param: /gateway/route?version=v1. Add to runbook.

jen: Adding those rollback thresholds to release notes. Also set abort if pinned-tenant traffic > 5% of total by preflight. I'll update notes and the internal changelog.

matt: I pushed a short blurb to release_notes: call out header-case sensitivity (old clients may send `x-api-version: v1`). Migration note + SDK patch link: https://internal.docs/sdk/1.4.2->1.5.0

chris: Monitoring plan: p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, streaming-422 rate, downstream redis errors. I'll be on-call for the rollout and watch those dashboards.

lucy: Pinlist updated in deploybot: tenants t-123,t-456,t-789; mobile_sdk<1.4.2; streaming=true. Patch rolled: deploybot pinlist apply 2026-03-23T18:10Z.

deploybot: pinlist applied. Active window 03:00-06:00 UTC. Auto-rollback enabled on: 5xx rate > 0.75% OR streaming-422 > 0.5% sustained for 5m. Warmup delay=120s between steps.

jen: :thumbsup: Ops-eyes scheduled at 02:45 UTC. If anything noisy, ping @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: I'll be up for the window. I've muted expected alert noise and left the high-signal alerts enabled. If rollback triggers I'll coordinate infra and tenant comms.

ops-runner: Small infra note: warm cache step required for Dedicated — set `--warm-cache=true` on run or we spike cold KV misses.

matt: Also pushing an SDK hotfix doc and note to the release notes about strict header negotiation for v2. Will notify partners slack after cutover.

jen: OK locking the change window unless objections by EOD PST. If no objections we'll proceed with the scheduled rollout and the pinned exceptions in place. Thanks everyone.
